correctness.rationale: Threefold symmetry gives first two complex moments zero; the stationary generator applied to z^n U^{-n} yields an exact 3-factor product with signed imaginary term. Independent 3-by-3 generator inversion, 80 numerical configurations, 4 exact rational parameter configurations and 180000 renewal samples agree. Gaussian thermal perturbations have vanishing pure complex cumulants above order two and do not change the cubic moment. Convex-hull support, symmetry and minimality arguments reconstruct all domain and boundary cases.

value.rationale: Identifies the minimal three-heading mechanism by which spatial measurements alone reveal irreversible heading bias, despite blind first and second pure complex moments, and proves an exact all-rate nonzero witness robust to arbitrary independent isotropic thermal diffusion. Structural sharpness is shown by the two-heading reflection obstruction; the positive practical purpose is static chirality detection without observing heading trajectories.
